claim: The reproduction script detected a context-overflow rejection.
why_it_looked_true: The expected status code (HTTP 400) arrived, from the expected server, inside the expected experiment.
what_killed_it: Running it on the platform the writeup was about. A 44 KB prompt was passed to jq as a command-line argument; Windows caps the command line near 32 KB, so jq died, curl sent an empty body, and the server replied 400 'missing request body'. The request was never sent.

numbers.platform: Windows only; Linux allows ~2 MB and the bug never fires

cost: about 30 minutes in a public repository
generalizable: The tool built to demonstrate that instruments fabricate phenomena was fabricating the phenomenon.
lesson: Require the response body to actually name the condition before asserting it. Anything else is REQUEST FAILED, and the summary must say that nothing was proved.

claim: The static checker found a degenerate scorer in one wave and faulty exception handling in seven others.
why_it_looked_true: The checker was written specifically to catch those classes of error, so its output read as authority.
what_killed_it: Two independent defects. (1) Verdict names were held as an allowlist, so a wave using different words was flagged. (2) In `reply, sec, verdict, correct, err = "", 0.0, "ERROR", False, msg` the checker collected every right-hand value when `verdict` appeared on the left, counting the empty string as a verdict name.

numbers.after: 5 FAIL, of which 2 are genuine and 2 are exemptions declared in-file

generalizable: If everything passes the checker is worthless; if everything fails it is broken.
lesson: Calibrate a checker on known-good code before trusting a single finding.

claim: There are zero paired cells between the base model and its distilled counterpart.
why_it_looked_true: A '0' printed by a working program reads as a fact about the world.
what_killed_it: The stratification key was `science_epoch`, a fingerprint that includes the model name, so base and student always fall in different epochs by construction. Pairing on `instrument_epoch` instead produced 85 cells.
cost: briefly read as 'there is no data'
generalizable: A zero from your own aggregator is a hypothesis about your key.
lesson: Suspect the key before the world.

claim: Small models warn about context overflow and large models lie about it. It is a question of model size.
why_it_looked_true: A 4B and a 9B returned HTTP 400 with a clear message; a 14B returned HTTP 200 with a silently truncated prompt. Three points, cleanly ordered by size.
what_killed_it: Pulling a stock 4B of the same family. It truncates identically to the 14B. The two that refuse are both GGUFs imported from elsewhere; swapping only the chat template on identical weights flips the behaviour.
cost: reached a draft intended for publication; caught before posting because the claim named a stock model tag that had never been measured
generalizable: Three points that happen to sit on your disk in a suggestive order are not a mechanism. The relevant variable was invisible in the framing that produced the observation.
lesson: Do not put a model tag you have not measured next to a measured figure.

claim: Interference is determined by the type of distractor, not the amount. Same-field, same-format distractors cause a one-step collapse; quantity does not matter.
why_it_looked_true: Varying distractor count (1, 3, 8, 20) left a 4B at 0.00 throughout, while changing the distractor type moved it from 1.00 to 0.00 in a single step. It was the highest-ranked proposition in the working ledger.
what_killed_it: Rebuilding the measurement as a single ordinal ladder (unrelated prose / same format / same field / same field unmarked / same field repeatedly overwritten) with one harness, one scene generator and one scoring rule. Across three Qwen3 models and ~5,000 rows the first four rungs sit at 1.00 up to eighty distractors; only the overwrite rung degrades.
cost: several days of accumulated n on a proposition ranked first
generalizable: The earlier task asked which of several records was the answer; the new task names the field. Same word, different question. This is the concrete form of a methodological complaint the field has already voiced.
lesson: State how you distinguish signal from distractor, or the result is ambiguous between opposite hypotheses.

claim: The published description of a baseline model as 'unable to finish' is a misattribution; the truncation was a generation budget artifact.
why_it_looked_true: All baseline outputs sat at about 2,480 tokens with a spread of ten, i.e. pinned to a ceiling. Nine of them ended mid-UTF-8-character.
what_killed_it: The same dataset. Not one of 130 baseline drafts stopped on its own below the ceiling. A model that never terminates does not benefit from a larger budget. An independent measurement of stop-token log mass separated the untrained from the trained checkpoint by +16.6 nat.
cost: the correction was written into three manuscripts and reissued the same day
generalizable: Suspicion has a sign. A day spent proving that instruments manufacture apparent model deficits creates a bias toward blaming the instrument.
lesson: Before concluding 'the ceiling caused it', count how many individuals stopped below the ceiling.

claim: Distillation improves following of an updated instruction.
what_killed_it: n was raised to about 144 and the direction reversed.
cost: one report, corrected the same day
generalizable: Honest reading of real numbers at a sample size that cannot support a direction.

claim: At a decoding-time steering coefficient near 2, general capability degrades while instruction-following and retrieval hold. This would imply an alignment tax separable at inference time with no retraining.
why_it_looked_true: n=4 per cell showed exactly that pattern, and it would have been a valuable result.
what_killed_it: n=12. The band is gone; everything collapses together between alpha 1.2 and 1.5.

numbers.n12: general 0.17, retrieval 0.33, instruction 0.33; collapse begins between 1.2 and 1.5

generalizable: This occurred after case G had already been recorded. Writing the lesson down did not prevent the repeat.
lesson: A rule with a number in it prevents this; an intention to be careful does not.
